result.fundName: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 5.19% (19.25% vs 14.06%).
Beat the benchmark in 100.0% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Flexi Cap.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.72 vs benchmark 1.13, Sortino 2.38.
Defensive profile: beta 0.60 with 24% lower volatility than the benchmark.
Positive alpha of 12.14% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.28).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -17.56% vs benchmark -34.16%.
Rolling return range spans 14.19% to 22.20% (8.01 pp spread) — consistency score 100.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
